definitions.name: evalLiteral
definitions.value: fun a l => a l.1 == l.2

definitions.name: evalClause
definitions.value: fun a c => List.any c (evalLiteral a)

definitions.name: evalCNF
definitions.value: fun a f => List.all f (evalClause a)

definitions.name: cnfVars
definitions.value: fun f => List.flatMap (fun c => List.map Prod.fst c) f

statement: ∀ (f : CNF) (a b : Nat → Bool), (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ cnfVars f → a n = b n) → evalCNF a f = evalCNF b f
proof:
by
  have transport (f : CNF) (a b : Nat → Bool)
      (same : ∀ n : Nat, n ∈ cnfVars f → a n = b n) :
      evalCNF a f = true → evalCNF b f = true := by
    intro ha
    apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hla⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp ((List.all_eq_true.mp ha) c hc)
    apply List.any_eq_true.mpr
    refine ⟨l, hl, ?_⟩
    have member : l.1 ∈ cnfVars f :=
      List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨c, hc, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩⟩
    simpa [evalLiteral, ← same l.1 member] using hla
  intro f a b same
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · exact transport f a b same
  · have back : ∀ n : Nat, n ∈ cnfVars f → b n = a n := by
      intro n hn
      exact Eq.symm (same n hn)
    exact transport f b a back
